verdict: The bracket algebra and compact-support estimate are correct conditional on order-m and order-(m+1) pointwise bounds. The original C_{n,r}=b_r instantiation is superseded as an induction-integrability proof because it assumes the target theorem. A noncircular fixed-(n,r) crude moment envelope closes the compact-support stochastic endpoint; this is an auxiliary reconstruction, not a BKL-stated lemma.

claims.claim: For isotropic log-concave nu and integer r >= 2, R_r^nu <= b_r I with b_r = K^(r-1)((r-1)!)^2; one may take C_{n,r}=b_r.
claims.source_pointer: PDF p.18, Theorem 4.1, eq. (66); TeX eq_cumulant_bound and eq_induction_constants

claims.claim: For deterministic unit u, q_t=<A_tu,u> and E_m(t)=|kappa_m(t)(u)|_t^2 satisfy E_m(t) <= b_m q_t pathwise when the order-m bound is available for every compactly supported isotropic log-concave posterior.
claims.source_pointer: PDF p.20-21, eqs. (75)-(77); TeX eq_covariance_norm, eq_cumulant_energy, eq_affine_cumulant

claims.claim: For isotropic initial mu, E A_t=e^-t I, hence E q_t=e^-t.
If M is the local martingale part of E_m, its coordinate coefficients are g_i=2<T~,W~_i>-<T~,Sigma_{H~_i}T~> in the A_t^{-1/2}-normalized coordinates.
claims.source_pointer: PDF pp.22-23, eqs. (81)-(88); TeX eq_energy_pair, eq_normalized_coefficients, eq_joint_energy_expansion

claims.claim: sum_i g_i^2 <= 8 E_m E_{m+1}+16(m-1)^2 E_m^2 pathwise.
claims.source_pointer: PDF p.21 eq. (79), p.23 eqs. (90)-(91); TeX eq_covariance_noise_bound, eq_energy_identifications, eq_metric_error_bound

claims.claim: With C_{n,r}=b_r, the displayed bracket integral is correct after Theorem 4.1, but this choice is circular as a justification for the same induction. For the noncircular gate substitute the crude fixed-order constants C_{n,r}=n^(r-1)J_r^2 derived from one-dimensional isotropic log-concave moments and the moment-cumulant partition identity.
claims.source_pointer: Uses PDF eqs. (67),(70),(77),(79),(88),(90),(91); support preservation is from positive density in (67); final integration uses Tonelli. BKL does not state q_t or this bracket estimate.

claims.claim: The D^2-dependent bracket estimate alone does not pass through BKL's compact-support approximation to noncompact initial measures without a uniform bound on D or another tail estimate.
claims.source_pointer: BKL PDF p.19 compact-support reduction and p.25-26 induction conclusion; reconstructed bracket constant depends explicitly on support diameter.

claims.claim: The b_r-only version of this gate presupposes the order-m and order-(m+1) target cumulant bounds and cannot justify the induction expectation step; this attempted closure is superseded by the independent crude C_{n,r} moment envelope recorded in kls_proof_audit/FINAL_REPORT.md and probability_kinetics/FINAL_REPORT.md.
claims.source_pointer: BKL induction at PDF pp.24-26; compare the fixed-order moment-cumulant envelope in the two updated reports.

claims.claim: For each fixed dimension n and order r, every isotropic log-concave nu satisfies R_r^nu <= C_{n,r} I with C_{n,r}=n^(r-1) J_r^2, where J_r follows from uniform one-dimensional isotropic log-concave moment bounds and the moment-cumulant partition formula.
claims.source_pointer: kls_proof_audit/FINAL_REPORT.md lines 165-206; independent reconstruction in probability_kinetics/FINAL_REPORT.md.

claims.claim: For fixed n,m and compactly supported isotropic log-concave initial mu, the crude envelopes C_{n,m}, C_{n,m+1}, the pathwise support bound q_t<=D^2, and E q_t=e^-t imply E<M>_infinity<=D^2[8 C_{n,m}C_{n,m+1}+16(m-1)^2 C_{n,m}^2]; the energy local martingale is L2 and the integrated Ito limit holds for all T->infinity, subject to the lower-order drift-integrability hypothesis.
claims.source_pointer: BKL v1 PDF pp.19-23, equations (67),(70),(77),(79),(81),(85),(88),(90),(91), plus Tonelli and the fixed-order moment envelope in kls_proof_audit/FINAL_REPORT.md.

assumptions_and_costs.initial_measure: Isotropic log-concave probability law with compact support for the D-dependent bracket estimate.
assumptions_and_costs.posterior: At each finite t the posterior is equivalent to the initial law and has the same essential support; its affine whitening is compactly supported, isotropic, and log-concave.
assumptions_and_costs.constants: Use C_{n,r}=n^(r-1)J_r^2 for the noncircular fixed-order integrability justification; the target dimension-free b_r belongs only to the final cumulant theorem and is not needed to justify the Ito expectations.
assumptions_and_costs.diameter: If D is support diameter, q_t <= D^2 pathwise (sharper D^2/4 by Popoviciu); the output is dimension-free only in the cumulant constants, not in the D-dependent bracket cost.
assumptions_and_costs.expectation_exchange: Tonelli for the nonnegative bracket density plus E q_t=e^-t and q_t<=D^2; the result gives finite expected bracket and L^2 martingale convergence.
assumptions_and_costs.fixed_order_envelope: C_{n,r} is uniform over time and all isotropic log-concave posteriors at fixed n,r, but is not dimension-free or order-uniform.
